title: Direct-to-Consumer Retail Brand
peek: CAC had outpaced LTV for three straight quarters, growth was funded rather than earned.
pain: Paid acquisition scaled faster than retention could support it; every new cohort paid back slower than the last.
fix: Rebuilt the growth model around a retention-first flywheel, reallocating spend from acquisition to a first-90-days experience.

title: Neobank / Deposits App
peek: Deposits were growing, but 70% of new users churned before their third month.
pain: Onboarding optimized for account creation, not for the moment a user actually felt the product’s value.
fix: Redesigned onboarding around a single early activation moment, cutting time-to-value from nine days to under one.

title: Mid-Market B2B SaaS
peek: The sales cycle stretched to nine months as buying committees grew from two to six.
pain: Reps were re-explaining value to every new stakeholder instead of arming the champion to sell internally.
fix: Built a champion-enablement kit: a one-page internal pitch the buyer could forward without the rep in the room.

title: Legacy Industrial Manufacturer
peek: Margins compressed 400bps as private-label competitors undercut on price alone.
pain: Competing on price against players with structurally lower costs was a fight the business couldn’t win.
fix: Repositioned around a premium service tier, with guaranteed lead times and on-site support that competitors couldn’t match.
